integrity: Exact symbolic inversion on the two-edge motif and exact-rational sampled tests support the fully specified analytical proof; finite testing is not proof for arbitrary hypergraphs. Originality is based on statement-level comparisons of inspected primary materials and mathematical searches, not a claim of exhaustive literature exclusion.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite undirected-edge weighted hypergraphs with positive normalized edge-dependent influence roles and to the equilibrium of the specified directed Friedkin-Johnsen projection. Does not address transient opinion sums, nonlinear updates, or arbitrary normalization. Independent validation has not occurred; equivalent specialized prior work outside inspected sources is possible.
title: Incidence-cycle classification of mean-neutral heterogeneous group influence
